title: Rebuilding After 9/11, Cantor Fitzgerald's Annual Charity, Eye on Energy Markets
description:
Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Former NY Fed President, Bill Dudley. Tom Michaud KBW CEO. Ed Skyler Former NYC Deputy Mayor. Matt DiLiberto, SL Green CFO. Ed Morse Hartree Partners Senior Advisor And Commodities analyst, Brandon Lutnick, Cantor Fitzgerald Chariman and Kyle Lutnick Cantor Fitzgerald Vice Chariman.

00:09:34 - KBW CEO on re-building Manhattan after 9/11
